sources.title: Everyone Can Have a (Digital) Assistant, with Ellis AI
sources.supports: named internal multi-model assistant platform and team use

financial_anchor.value: $836m core EBITDA; GAAP net income attributable $204m
financial_anchor.caveat: Non-GAAP/GAAP and cycle/pass-through reconciliation in dossier.

ai_claim.claim: CBRE describes Ellis AI as a self-service multi-model GenAI platform used by teams for digital-assistant workflows.
ai_claim.stage: E2 scoped company-reported deployment; no E3 controlled economics
ai_claim.limitation: Company case description lacks a matched quality, adoption and retained-cash cohort.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: 2025 transaction recovery, acquisitions, pass-through facilities costs, incentive compensation and real-estate cycle explain much growth; clients own building data and can demand savings
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Multiple ordinary drivers and contract capture.

rights_limit: Landlord, tenant, building and vendor data is contract/license-bound; management access does not imply cross-client training rights.
materiality_summary: $184m annual pre-tax using 5% of $3.680bn TTM core EBITDA only as a reported-profit scale proxy
g2_provisional: Incomplete: E1/E2 tools without controlled property/workflow cash.
